'''Hagen Longmyre''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] member of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], she encountered a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic spacer]] and was defeated.
